Job-Description:
## Job title
Preschool Teacher

## Job Summary
The perfect candidate for this position will have an understanding heart, a passion for teaching, and be experienced in early childhood education. They should not only have the ability to manage the entirety of a preschool classroom, but they should also have the knowledge and ability to address learning disorders that may arise. Time management and problem-solving are vital skills. Lastly, a sensitivity and positive perspective towards multi-cultures is mandatory.

## Required Skills
- Classroom Management 
- Early Childhood Education
- Knowledge of Learning Disorders
- Time Management
- Problem-Solving Skills
- Multicultural Sensitivity/Awareness

## Required Experience
- Minimum 2 years experience in preschool
- At least 4 years in Special education environment

## Responsibilities
- To educate and ensure wellbeing of children aged 2-5 years
- To handle lesson planning and also stimulate emotional, intellectual, and social growth of each child
- To seamlessly manage operation of the preschool
- Supervise and interact with kids in an enhancing and nurturing way
